AAF.caption: Email (Optional)
AAF.doc: This is optional, you can send more properties with custom names and values by `Set User Property` action.
AAF.name: email

AAG.caption: User Unique ID
AAG.doc: The ID can by anything, but is usually the unique ID that bubble add to users.
AAG.name: uid

AAH.caption: Identifying Users _________________________________________________________
AAH.doc: If a user was previously anonymous (because they hadn't signed up or logged in yet), we'll automatically alias their anonymous ID with their new unique ID. That means all their events from before and after they signed up will be shown under the same user.
AAH.name: user_login

AAI.caption: Note _________________________________________________________
AAI.doc: To make sure you understand which user is performing actions within your app, you can identify users at any point. From the moment you make this call, all events will be identified with that distinct id.
AAI.name: identifying_users

AAk.caption: Person properties JSON
AAk.doc: Optional. A JSON object as text, for example {"plan_count": 3, "is_trial": true}. Unlike the key/value list, JSON keeps numbers, booleans and lists typed. Invalid JSON is ignored with a console warning.
AAk.name: properties_json
